title: Read documentation of Agent Stack and update local CLAUDE.md
description: Look into Agent Stack SDK documentation and update local CLAUDE.md with improtant bits related to how to use SDK in the project. Be concise and pick only important bits that are relevant.
steps: Read purpose of the project and technical constraints
Read Agent Stack SDK documentation
Update local CLAUDE.md with improtant bits related to how to use SDK in the project
Focus on LLM extensions, context tokens and basic chat functionality

title: Setup empty Vite project
description: Setup empty Vite project with React and TypeScript and proxy to Agent Stack instance
steps: Create empty Vite project with React and TypeScript
Setup proxy to Agent Stack instance
Add empty component to display Hello World to use the UI later on

title: Provide pnpm check script to verify the project is fully functional
description: Check for typing errors and linting errors
steps: Install eslint
Add basic eslint config
Add typing errors check
Add pnpm check script to verify the project is fully functional - both typing and linting

title: Provide pnpm test that would start E2E tests using Playwright
description: Add Playwright to the project and setup empty E2E test that would check if the project is fully functional
steps: Install Playwright
Add empty Playwright test that can be started and always passes
Add pnpm test script to start Playwright tests

title: Add minimalistic UI with chat bubbles for agent and user, button to  send message
description: The goal of this is to have non-functional UI that would serve as a basis for the future integration with real agent. The implementation is meant to be minimalistic and non-functional, just basic styling and layout.
steps: Install shadcn as UI library
Create layout for the page
Add chat bubbles for agent and user
Add button to send message
Dont include any logic for sending message, just basic styling and layout
Add e2e test that tests the behaviour - very simple smoke check

title: Integrate the basic UI with Agent Stack using the SDK
description: Create fully funnctional chat interface that allows simple communication with the agent using the SDK. Use existing UI foundation.
steps: Install a2a js SDK
Install @agentstack/sdk
Ensure context token is generated correctly
Ensure LLM extension is resolved correctly
Pipe the user message to the agent and display the response
Allow multi turn conversations with the agent
Implement e2e test that checks the behaviour - basically sending something like Hi and expecting some agent response
